# Lab 2.1: Create Datasets the Right Way

## What We Are Going to Do
Create datasets with a location, default table expiration, labels, default collation and case-insensitive names, using the console, the CLI and SQL.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create a dataset.** In Explorer, click the **⋮** next to your project → **Create dataset**:
   - **Dataset ID**: `lab02`
   - **Location type**: Multi-region → **US**
   - **Default table expiration**: off
   - Under **Advanced options**, keep Google-managed encryption.

   Click **Create dataset**.

2. **[CLI] Create a dataset with expiration and labels.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset \
  --default_table_expiration=604800 \
  --description="Scratch tables that delete themselves after 7 days" \
  --label=course:bigquery --label=module:m02 \
  $PROJECT_ID:lab02_scratch
bq show --format=prettyjson lab02_scratch | grep -E "location|defaultTableExpirationMs|labels" -A2</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Create a case-insensitive dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SCHEMA lab02_ci
OPTIONS (
  location = 'US',
  default_collation = 'und:ci',
  is_case_insensitive = TRUE,
  description = 'Case-insensitive names and string comparisons',
  labels = [('course', 'bigquery')]
);

CREATE TABLE lab02_ci.Cities (name STRING);
INSERT INTO lab02_ci.cities (name) VALUES ('Surat'), ('SURAT');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches FROM lab02_ci.CITIES WHERE name = 'surat';</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The table name works in any case, and the `und:ci` collation makes `'surat'` match both rows.

4. **[CLI] Try to change the location.** There is no flag for it. Location is fixed when a dataset is created. To move data, you copy it to a new dataset.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq update --default_table_expiration=0 lab02_scratch
bq update --set_label=owner:ankit lab02</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Check the details.** Open each dataset's **Details** tab. Compare location, labels, expiration and collation.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `lab02` | US, no expiration |
| `lab02_scratch` | Tables expire after 7 days |
| `lab02_ci` | Case-insensitive names and values, query returns `2` |
| Location | Cannot be changed after creation |
